relevance_note: Case report of a boy with a LAMP2 variant: "A hemizygous likely pathogenic variant was reported: LAMP2:c.645_651del (p.Lys215Asnfs25), resulting in diagnosis of Danon disease (DD)."
method_note: Short case report, read in full; JSON built by a small Python script in the scratch directory from values I typed after reading, with each span resolved to the paper's exact characters (the paper uses non-breaking spaces, e.g. 'Sun et al^5') and checked verbatim. Three individuals: the case-report patient ('patient', rule 5) and two previously published patients summarised in the Discussion with individual-level facts (sex, age, variant, features), labelled by rule 4 as 'ref 5 patient' (Sun et al) and 'ref 6 patient' (Shalata et al), reference numbers taken from the superscripts ^5 and ^6. Contradiction/inconsistency: the protein change is printed as 'p.LysAsnfs∗25' in the Abstract and 'p.Lys215Asnfs25' in the Investigations text; the latter (with position) was recorded. No transcript printed. ACMG criteria are described in words (very strong / moderate pathogenic criteria) but no codes are printed, so acmg_criteria_as_stated is 'not reported'. No parental testing reported; inheritance 'not reported'. Age at onset left 'not reported' for the patient: 14 years is the age at presentation, and the headaches 'since 6 years of age' are recorded as feature onset only. No age at genetic diagnosis is stated for the patient (heart transplantation at 15.8 years is in treatment_summary). Vital status 'alive' rests on the follow-up sentence after transplantation. 'Exclusive cardiac involvement' (patient) and 'only cardiac involvement' (ref 5) were recorded as an excluded 'extracardiac involvement' feature but were not used to exclude specific checklist items (skeletal myopathy, intellectual disability etc.), since they are global statements; 'assessed for other complications, which were ruled out' was likewise not used. 'Physical examinations yielded no significant findings' is recorded as the paper words it (excluded 'significant findings on physical examination'); it excludes nothing more specific. LVOT obstruction excluded from 'nonobstructive left ventricular (LV) hypertrophy'. Short PR interval counted as observed for the ventricular pre-excitation checklist item; 'Wolf-Parkinson-White pattern' (spelled thus) for ref 6. Heart failure is mentioned only as a general feature of DD, not for the patient, so not reported. For ref 6, 'At 18 years of age ... molecular testing confirmed' was taken as age at diagnosis; the 'deletion of 110.5 kb at Xq24' has no HGVS, cDNA, protein or genomic coordinates (Xq24 is a cytoband, not recorded as coordinates).

treatment_summary.value: beta-blocker carvedilol; fibrinolytic therapy (alteplase) for LV thrombus; implantable cardioverter-defibrillator; discharged on carvedilol, sacubitril/valsartan, spironolactone, dapagliflozin, amiodarone and enoxaparin; heart transplantation at 15.8 years of age
span: the patient was started on β-blocker therapy with carvedilol (6.25 mg daily)
which was treated successfully with fibrinolytic therapy (alteplase 0.01 mg/kg/h over 8 hours)

The patient underwent placement of an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator and was discharged with carvedilol 12.5 mg, sacubitril/valsartan 50 mg, spironolactone 50 mg, dapagliflozin 10 mg, amiodarone 100 mg daily, and enoxaparin 60 mg twice daily
the patient underwent heart transplantation at 15.8 years of age
